facts.fact: The Information Regulator, on the Enforcement Committee's report, found FT Rams Consulting in breach of POPIA sections 12, 18 and 69 over unsolicited direct-marketing emails, and ordered it to stop and to file an undertaking, privacy policy, impact assessment and compliance framework within 90 days.
